notes.title: Trackers, Oculus, Combo!
notes.content:
[i]v0.5.0[/i]
[img]http://fight4dream.com/steamuseimages/vrmonsterawakens/v0_5_0_GIF.gif[/img]
Hello Monsters! We are very excited to bring these features to you!
[list]
[*]Strap two [i]Vive Trackers[/i] on your feet, and you can Kick with your feet!
[*]Grab two [i]Touch[/i] controllers and you can play with [i]Oculus[/i]!
[*]Destroy quickly for combo score! How high can your score be?
[*]More languages support! Parlez-vous Français? Spreek je Nederlands?
[*]Bug fixes and Performance tuning.
[/list]
The fun never stops! Coming next is our new monster. Who is he?
Multiplayer is in progress too. Don't miss the fun!

notes.title: Fear my Beam Shot!
notes.content:
[i]v0.4.1[/i]
[img]http://fight4dream.com/steamuseimages/vrmonsterawakens/v0_4_1_GIF_BeamShoot-p.gif[/img]
Hello Monsters! Here are some of the key changes for the upcoming patch:
[list]
    [*]Main menu is renovated, added a news section.
    [*]Improved visual effect of Somnilla's Beam Shot!
    [*]The beam will be displayed correctly when viewed from airship.
    [*]Soldiers caught fire from the beam and other sources will flee instead of attack.
    [*]Soldiers will be dropped from damaged tanks and helicopters.
    [*]Reduced the nuclear bomb destruction radius when Boss Tank appears. 
    [*]Trigger tutorials in the right time.
    [*]Minor bug fixes.
[/list]
Have fun and enjoy the SMASH!

notes.title: Let's Jump!
notes.content:
[i]v0.4.0[/i]
[img]http://fight4dream.com/steamuseimages/vrmonsterawakens/v0_4_0_GIF_Jump01.gif[/img]
Hello Monsters! Here are some of the key changes for the upcoming patch:
[list]
    [*]New control methods. We have renewed the tutorial videos and added a control panel. 
    [*]Jump and stomp on where you landed.
    [*]Hop to the roofs to admire the city view before it crumbles under your might.
    [*]Score is listed on the leaderboard even being wasted. 
    [*]Added a Retry Button after being wasted. 
    [*]The enemies and citizen will be easier to catch up.

notes.title: Big Arcade Mode Update!

tags.feature: Enhanced environment of Rainy Days;
Arcade mode mission now required to destroy as much as possible within certain survival time;
Show a warning message when getting too close to the edges of battle zone;
Added 3rd person cut-scene when defeated;
Scores and Rank are now available when area or stage cleared;

tags.balance_change: Reduced HP restore of health pot in boss battle;
Boss Tank laser can no longer be blocked, watch out!

tags.bug: Fixed eye-closing effect when critically hurt;
Fixed a bug for eye-closing effect after moving to next area;
Fixed hit detection for some of the buildings;
Fixed Tank AI;
Fixed helicopter crashing into buildings;
Fixed performance issue.

notes.title: Boss Fight Update

tags.feature: Addition of traditional and simplified Chinese UI supports for selection;

tags.bug: Player can no longer stand inside the boss 3D model;
Player will be knocked back if boss rush into the player;
Fixed improper spawn position problem;
Boss will be more active and not wander around;

tags.feature: Throwing vehicles onto buildings will now deal damages to the buildings;
Support mixed reality video capture;
3rd person camera news banner available and upgraded visual effect of healing by eating citizen;
Airship can be destroyed! Watch it engulfed in fire and fall!
Extra mission targets for arcade mode;

tags.balance_change: Tanks and helicopters are heavier now, throw them onto buildings to smash them harder;
You can chase citizens more easily, they are not athletes after all;

tags.bug: Fixed the disappearing of citizens and vehicles when played for a long time.
